answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, revoked by a single upheld challenge, idle agents bleed standing. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Reaching the wander of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The ocean is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the pearl.
